method: Rows built from consensus.json + fold_and_lineup.json; every URL re-fetched 2026-10-05 (curl; Android Headlines/Digital Trends blocked curl, so earlier same-session copies plus WebFetch were used). Dates from page datePublished metadata. Software version recorded only if the page states it.

totals.note: Previous files said 24 reviews / 17 outlets: that counted only consensus.json (slab phones). The full research set is 35 documents from 20 outlets: 24 slab reviews in consensus.json + 2 slab reviews only in fold_and_lineup.json (Android Central Pixel 11, Digital Trends Pixel 11 Pro) + 9 Fold reviews.

corrections: The Guardian Pixel 11 Pro URL in consensus.json (.../pixel-11-review-googles-best-pocket-camera-goes-customisable) returns 404; correct URL is .../sep/10/pixel-11-pro-review-googles-best-pocket-camera-goes-customisable.
Dates corrected from page metadata: TechRadar Pixel 11 Pro 2026-09-03 (consensus.json said '2026-08'); Android Central Pixel 11 Pro 2026-08-19; GSMArena Pixel 11 2026-09-15, Pro XL 2026-09-04.

Tom's Guide, TechRadar and Android Central are all Future plc titles (pages credit 'Future'; Android Central cites 'our parent company's Future Labs'). Tom's Guide and Android Central report identical Pro/Pro XL charging figures (51%/54% in 30 min): treat their lab numbers as ONE measurement, not two.
Henry Burrell's Pro XL review appears on both Trusted Reviews and Tech Advisor; counted once.
